definition: to be alarmed, suddenly afraid, frightened, scared; to be terrified.
example_en: The child was terrified by the sound of thunder.

definition: thought of apart from any particular instances or material objects; not concrete; abstract.

example_en: That accountant keeps the accounts neatly.

example_en: Thursday is the market day.

definition: to stretch too long; to be elongated to a greater degree.
example_en: He stretched the rubber band too long.

definition: one of the precious metals; gold.
example: ಅವನು ಒಂದು ನಿಷ್ಕ ಚಿನ್ನವನ್ನು ದೇವಸ್ಥಾನಕ್ಕೆ ಅರ್ಪಿಸಿದನು.
example_en: He offered a niska of gold to the temple.

definition: a man who awakes, wakes up another; an awakener.
example: ಆ ಸ್ವಾಮಿ ಜನರ ಮನಸ್ಸನ್ನು ಎಚ್ಚರಿಸುವ ಪ್ರತಿಬೋಧಕರಾಗಿದ್ದರು.
example_en: That swami was an awakener who roused people's minds.

definition: the pleasing chirping sound of a parrot.
example_en: The parrot's pleasing chirping filled the house.

definition: to be or get, enlightened or taught.
example_en: He got enlightened with good things from the teacher.

definition: a kind of plant used in preparing antidotes.
example_en: The healer prepared medicine from the biḷi rakkasi plant.

definition: the fact of knowing another person, but not intimately.
example_en: What exists between the two of us is only a casual acquaintance.

definition: a long-established custom or practice; a tradition.
example_en: This custom is being followed as a long-established tradition.

definition: (growth of someone or something) to be checked; to have stunted growth.
example_en: The plant grown in the shade had its growth stunted.

definition: a garland of flowers.
example_en: They adorned the bride with a beautiful garland of flowers.

definition: the tree Canarium commune of Burseraceae family.
example: ಹಾಲಮಡ್ಡಿ ಮರದಿಂದ ಸೋರುವ ಅಂಟನ್ನು ಧೂಪಕ್ಕೆ ಬಳಸುತ್ತಾರೆ.
example_en: The resin oozing from the halamaddi tree is used for incense.

definition: heard well, clearly.
example_en: Her words were heard clearly by everyone.

definition: one of the Śaiva clans.
example_en: That member of the Pūrvaśaiva clan worshipped Shiva every day.

definition: the deciduous tree Anogeissus latifolia (= Conocarpus latifolia) of Combretaceae family, with hard wood which is used for making agricultural implements, boats, etc.
example: ಆ ಡಿಂಡಲ ಮರದ ಮರಮುಟ್ಟು ಬಹಳ ಗಟ್ಟಿಯಾಗಿದೆ.
example_en: The timber of that dindala tree is very hard.

definition: fearlessness; courage; intrepidity; dauntlessness.
example_en: He showed fearlessness in front of the enemies.

definition: a science dealing with minerals, their crystallography, properties, classification, and the ways of distinguishing them; mineralogy.
example_en: He is studying mineralogy at the university.

definition: the quality of being sweet; sweetnes.
example_en: The sweetness of the honey was tasty to the mouth.

definition: (one's strength, prowess) to excel.
example_en: His prowess excelled in the competition.

definition: to crush into bits or fine particles between two hard surfaces; to grind.
example_en: Mother ground chutney powder in the morning.

definition: to have or get an opportune time.
example_en: He got an opportune time to speak.

definition: the class of wealthy people in a society.
example: ಆ ಊರಿನ ತಿಜೂರಿವರ್ಗ ಹೊಸ ಶಾಲೆಯನ್ನು ಕಟ್ಟಿಸಿತು.
example_en: The wealthy class of that town got a new school built.

definition: a rifle with a long barrel.
example_en: The hunter set out to the forest carrying a long-barrelled rifle.

definition: a citizen of a country.
example_en: Every citizen has the right to vote.
